item.title: Turn Job Posts into Interview Questions 🎤 • Identify key skills and duties listed. • Create questions from these skills. • Use: "How have I demonstrated [skill] in past roles?" • Research company values for tailored questions. • Practice answering your new questions confidently. How can you use job descriptions to anticipate interview questions? #interview #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
